name: Rex
description: Rex is a playful 2-year-old Border Collie with boundless energy and a love for fetch. He is house-trained and great with older children.
care_notes: Daily exercise of at least 60 minutes. Brush coat twice a week. Thrives with mental stimulation.

name: Luna
description: Luna is a gentle 1-year-old Siamese cat who loves warm laps and sunny windowsills. She is quiet and adapts quickly to new homes.
care_notes: Indoor only. Brush weekly. Interactive play daily to prevent boredom.

name: Tweety
description: Tweety is a cheerful budgerigar who mimics sounds and enjoys human interaction. Comes hand-tamed from our aviary.
care_notes: Fresh water daily. Social species — consider keeping a pair. Cage minimum 60 cm wide.

name: Nemo
description: Nemo is a captive-bred clownfish ideal for a marine aquarium. Hardy and adaptable.
care_notes: Saltwater tank 100 l minimum. Temperature 24–26 °C. Feed twice daily with marine flake.

name: Fluffy
description: Fluffy is a Holland Lop rabbit with floppy ears and a calm temperament. Litter-trained and used to being handled.
care_notes: Daily hay as 80 % of diet. Fresh vegetables. Clean enclosure weekly. Needs daily free-roaming time.

name: Max
description: Max is a purebred German Shepherd with Schutzhund I title. Excellent temperament and fully trained for family protection.
care_notes: 2 hours exercise daily. Professional grooming every 6 weeks. Not suitable for first-time dog owners.

name: Pepper
description: Pepper is a hand-reared cockatiel with a friendly confident character. She whistles tunes and enjoys head scratches.
care_notes: Out-of-cage time at least 2 hours daily. Varied diet of seeds pellets and fresh fruit.

name: Goldie
description: Goldie is a fancy goldfish with a flowing twin tail. Perfect centrepiece for a cold-water aquarium.
care_notes: Cold-water tank 80 l minimum per fish. Weekly 20 % water change. Feed once daily.
